messages:
Rae (PM): quick idea: run a micro-DP activation test focused on 'activation ladder' — encourage tiny wins (token returned, schema pass, follow-up call signup). goal: cut time-to-first-value.
Diego (Eng): ok define the ladder steps so we can emit events. what are the exact probes?
Rae (PM): ladder=1) API key setup, 2) successful probe response with expected fields, 3) optional "book SE slot" click. measure within 7 days.
Nina (DevEx): I'll ship a minimal "guided run" modal in Console that walks them through keys -> probe -> survey. keep copy concise.
Tara (CS): include a pre-filled sample for common stacks (curl, Node) but avoid long code blocks. personalization = higher lift? we'll A/B it.
Li (Data): events: kp_setup, probe_ok, se_booked, survey_vote. Cohorts: dp=true, variant=A/B. I can run quick uplift calc.
Diego (Eng): estimate: modal + events = 2 dev-days; variant routing + FF = 1 day. we'll feature-flag.
Cal (SE): I'll offer 30-min office hours; prefer scheduling only after probe_ok so we avoid no-shows.
Rae (PM): launch gates: 1) +25% ladder completion at step2 with p<0.05 OR 2) auth-related tickets down 50%. also no regressions.
FlagBot: experiment "dp_activation_ladder_v1" created. CI: all checks passed.
Rae (PM): actions: Nina modal prototype today; Diego event schema + FF by EOD; Li analysis spec; Tara invite copy; reconvene Thu 11am preflight. Thanks!"
